narrative.overview: Pink-by-day scrapbook, neon-by-night. Warm blush paper, plum ink, thick outlines, hard offset shadows; glow reserved for things that are literally lights.
keyCharacteristics: Pink-on-blush by day, neon-on-plum by night, same token names in both themes.
Chunky 3px plum outlines with hard, un-blurred offset shadows.
Calistoga display serif, Libre Franklin body, Caveat for the handwritten voice.
Real LED behavior on exactly the elements that are lights.
Photography of real donated lights and real children leads; ornament follows.

rules.name: The Pink Is Memory Rule
rules.body: Pink is the one chromatic hue of the interface. The single exception is Filament Amber, which belongs to bulb glass in the hero garland and nowhere else.

rules.name: The Plum, Never Black Rule
rules.body: Outlines, shadows, and text use Plum Ink (#2a1620), never #000, except the photo mat behind neon lights.

rules.name: The Literal Light Rule
rules.body: Glow, flicker, and breathing belong only to things that are lights.

rules.name: The Italic Pink Rule
rules.body: One emphasized phrase per serif heading goes italic, regular weight, in Desiray Rose.

dos: Do use the existing CSS custom properties; both themes depend on them.
Do keep 3px plum outlines with zero-blur offset shadows on raised UI.
Do reserve glow and flicker for literal lights, and honor prefers-reduced-motion.
Do keep the shared header, footer, and theme toggle identical across every HTML page.
Do run every new piece of user text through escapeHTML.
Do verify a new component in both Lights On and Lights Off.
donts: Don't use soft gray blur shadows or 1px hairline cards as the primary container style.
Don't use pure black for outlines or text, except the photo mat.
Don't use clinical hospital blue, stock-photo smiles, or pity-driven imagery.
Don't put glow on headings, cards, or decorative blobs.
Don't rely on border color alone for focus on form fields.
Don't add a second brand hue or spread Filament Amber beyond bulb glass; the old tan/terracotta hero tokens were removed.
Don't use more than three bulb colors in the garland (Neon Pink, Filament Amber, Deep Rose) or more than about ten bulbs.
